name: pi-spec-flow
description: Evidence-bound spec workflow gates for the pi coding agent

scripts.typecheck: node --check core.mjs && node --check index.ts && node --check adapter-core.mjs && node --check project-profile.mjs
scripts.test: node --test core.test.mjs trustworthy.test.mjs adapter-core.test.mjs project-profile.test.mjs project-contracts.test.mjs action.test.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && node tests/e2e/e2e-commit-gate.mjs && node tests/e2e/e2e-trustworthy-closure.mjs && node tests/e2e/e2e-spec-discovery.mjs && node tests/e2e/e2e-project-governance-profile.mjs && node tests/e2e/e2e-private-action.mjs && node core.mjs check --ci
